title: Load orders and list admins for the console
description: Adds the repository helpers that the order history page and the internal admin console call to fetch their data.

expected.note: A query for the line items runs inside the loop over orders, so loading N orders issues N+1 round-trips and the cost grows with the result set. Fetch all items in one query (WHERE order_id = ANY($1)) and group them in memory.
password_hash is selected and returned to the caller even though the console only needs identity and role, spreading credential material beyond the auth path. Drop password_hash from the projection.
